rust_tests.operation_410_integration_tests: 5 passed, including two product CLI invocations

limitations: The CLI is not connected to the original GUI menu/dispatcher and is not a production default.
Timestamp, repeated-run, concurrency, and failure-event logging are not compared line-by-line with Python; synthetic CLI tests assert success log lines and empty-input produces an empty log.
Content-cell reads were parity-tested only on synthetic XLSX files; .xls content reads and .xlt are unverified.
Date-typed cells, formula cached values, multi-cell content specifications, real templates, real directories, and Windows-native Rust are unverified.
Hard-link target reservation can fail on filesystems that do not support hard links; the source remains when the rename fails safely.
Kylin/UOS, glibc 2.28, and offline deb packaging were not tested.
